versions.label: Xmodel V0.1
versions.description: GPU XGBoost trained on 60 Hz human OS recordings only and freshly regenerated 60 Hz bot datasets (challenge, tiers, families, humanlike).

versions.label: Xmodel V0.2
versions.description: Ymodel V0.3M-scale training mix: all OS+dashboard human CSVs and all bot sources (challenge, tiers, evasion, families) with every window downsampled to 60 Hz for remote/Tailscale parity.

versions.label: Xmodel V0.2S
versions.description: Native 60 Hz human recordings only (no downsampling) plus freshly regenerated Ymodel-scale bot datasets at native 60 Hz.

versions.label: Xmodel V0.3
versions.description: V0.2S native 60 Hz mix hardened with telemetry from the 11 dashboard-bot families that beat V0.2S during the timed red-team attack.

versions.label: Xmodel V0.3z
versions.description: V0.3 native 60 Hz dataset trained with Zmodel-style relative dx,dy,dt 1D CNN fused with 12 kinematic tabular features (ZNetV01).

versions.label: Xmodel V0.3.EA.01
versions.description: Evasion-arena child of xmodel_v0.3: native 60 Hz mix plus dashboard-bot episodes that scored >=65% human confidence against the previous iteration.

versions.label: Xmodel V0.3z.EA.01
versions.description: Evasion-arena child of xmodel_v0.3z: ZNet V0.3z retrained on native 60 Hz mix plus dashboard-bot episodes that scored >=65% human confidence.

versions.label: Xmodel V0.3z.EA.02
versions.description: Evasion-arena child of xmodel_v0.3z.EA.01: ZNet V0.3z retrained on native 60 Hz mix plus dashboard-bot episodes that scored >=65% human confidence.

versions.label: Xmodel V0.3z.EA.03
versions.description: Evasion-arena child of xmodel_v0.3z.EA.02: ZNet V0.3z retrained on native 60 Hz mix plus dashboard-bot episodes that scored >=65% human confidence.

versions.description: Evasion-arena child of xmodel_v0.3z.EA.03: ZNet V0.3z retrained on native 60 Hz mix plus dashboard-bot episodes that scored >=65% human confidence.
